Read the verdicts of a clip review

Source: R/import.R
fp_read_validation.Rd

Reads validation_by_clip.csv, the clip-by-clip result of the review step of the 'sheepdog' package, and returns the verdicts in a form that fp_aggregate() can attach to the occasions. Files written by the sampler up to version 1.2.0 (validacao_por_clipe.csv, with column names in Portuguese) are read as well.

Usage

fp_read_validation(path)

Arguments

path

Path of validation_by_clip.csv (or of the legacy validacao_por_clipe.csv).

Value

A data frame with one row per clip: site, species_code, file (the audio file the clip was cut from), start and end (in seconds within it), confidence, verdict (TRUE for a true detection, FALSE for a false one, NA for clips not reviewed), and occasion_id when the file has it.

Details

The format is detected from the columns: site marks the format of 'sheepdog' 2.0.0 and later, local the legacy one. The columns used are site, species_code, source_audio, clip_start, clip_end, confidence, and verdict (legacy: local, species_code, audio_origem, inicio_clipe, fim_clipe, confidence, veredito), and occasion_id (ocasiao_id) when present. Verdicts positive and negative (legacy: positivo, negativo) become TRUE and FALSE; not_reviewed and clip_missing (nao_validado, clipe_ausente) become NA, and any other value becomes NA with a warning.

The sampler can pick clips among the detections of a species by their confidence or at random. The models in crywolf treat the checked occasions as chosen independently of the classifier's score: clips picked for their high scores hold fewer false positives than a random sample, and would make the false-positive rate look lower than it is. Use clips drawn at random among the detections for this purpose. Clips of whole recordings (sampling_mode = "random_recordings", with no confidence) are a second, manual method of detection: give them to fp_data() as verified occasions, not to the validation argument of fp_aggregate().

See also

fp_aggregate()
